title: あと1曲！ あと1曲だけ……！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Yeah! Three! Two! One! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah! This is why concert DVDs are the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mm! Mmm! Glorious… Heavenly… Watching it is like reliving the concert all over…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait! What time is it?! I gotta go soon or I'm gonna be late!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, buut… right after this part is when they…

text_block_list.name: DVD Audio
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu! There's so much energy here tonight! The next song is a bit of a tearjerker. You know the one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooohoohoo! Even the setlist is divine! Every single aspect is just pure heaven!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just this song! I'll go right after this song!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, but the singer right after this is super awesome… Kehehe, fwaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Agnes Digital gets so caught up in her DVD that she forgets to go to training.
